title: docs(skills,docs): objectstack-platform and the metadata-lifecycle page teach the one effective read of a .custom declared override (ADR-0146 D8)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao8kpZNh2WHEhMcxiXxy3HZi)_

Fixes #28509
Part of #28236

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：平台 skill（`skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md`）在 Manifest Reference 新增一段「Customizing an installed package (ADR-0146)」：定制装好的包要写进配对的 `<base>.custom` 包，同名项在正文里声明 `overrides: { package, basedOn }` 才整份替换基础包的文档；读取只认配对包里的声明、只认可覆盖的类型、不判 `basedOn`、其他包的声明一律忽略；五个读取口径一致、全环境列表每名一项、孤儿行在 `overlay` 里报出、公开表单只收窄不重开、导出带声明。配套：eval 第 10 例、`@objectstack/skills` patch changeset、文档站 metadata-lifecycle 页一小节 + forms 页一句。
- **为什么改**：#28507 落地后读取已按声明服务，但 main 上没有任何 skill、也没有任何手写文档页提到 `.custom` / `overrides` / `basedOn`（只有从 spec `describe()` 生成的 `references/**` 页带着 schema 行），AI 作者仍按 Setup 覆盖行或无声明同名项来写，前者是待 D11 迁移的无包行，后者被读取当孤儿报出。
- **风险与回滚**：纯教学文本，不改 spec、不改运行时；回滚即 revert。风险在措辞与预算：SKILL.md 新增 1176 字节由同文件四处删重复支付（下文逐条点名），行上限 6014 不动、余量 0；若审读认为某处删除不算重复，替代方案是再收紧新段落而不是抬上限。
- **先看**：① `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` :134 新段；② 同文件四处删除（:93 段的「Runtime rule of thumb」表与其下句、:130 Object naming 承接 `tableName`/`sys_metadata` 两条拒绝、:400 Seed Data 的 `object` 派生句、:438 CLI 速查块、两处双横线）；③ `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx` :114–:143；④ `content/docs/ui/forms.mdx` :23 末句；⑤ evals 第 10 例 :95。
- **两分钟验证**：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs | grep objectstack-platform/SKILL`，预期 `6014 / 6014 (+0)`；`pnpm check:skill-identifier-liveness` 预期 OK（Seed Data 一节仍对 `SeedMode` 穷尽）；`git grep -n -E 'overrides:|basedOn|\.custom' -- skills/ content/docs/` 预期只命中本 PR 的三处文件。
- **需要你做的**：受管面（Tier H，`skills/**`）：席位跑完 Fable 契约复审并写好席位核对后，由您合并本 PR；无其他动作。

## What changes

Five files, text and one JSON fixture; no schema, no runtime code.

### `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` — the teaching (:134)

One paragraph in § Manifest Reference, after the `manifest.namespace (ADR-0048)` paragraph (the package-ownership paragraph; `basedOn` is the base's `manifest.version`, `package` its `manifest.id`). Each sentence is read from `main` at `071bda62`:

| Card point | Sentence | Source on `main` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| where it lives, what to write | a change to an installed base `hotcrm` lives in its paired writable package `hotcrm.custom`, which depends on it; the same-named item with `overrides: { package: 'hotcrm', basedOn: '3.2.0' }` replaces the base's document whole | ADR-0146 D2/D3; `packages/spec/src/kernel/override-declaration.zod.ts` (describe: `basedOn` = the base's `manifest.version`) |
| 1 | honoured only from the pair (the row's `package_id`), only for an overridable type (`OVERRIDABLE_METADATA_TYPES` in `@objectstack/spec/kernel`; not `flow`/`action` yet), `basedOn` never judged, any other package's declaration ignored | `packages/metadata-protocol/src/served-override.ts#isServedOverrideRowOf`; `customization-package.ts#OVERRIDE_TYPE_CLASSIFICATION`; `protocol.ts#declinesStoredRow` (a stored flow body is declined before the predicate is asked) |
| 1, 2 | no `?package`, `?package=hotcrm`, the layered read and both lists serve it; the env-wide list holds one item per name one code package ships; a dependent's stays under its own `?package=`; a package-unbound Setup row still wins over the base's until D11 | `protocol.ts#servedOverlayRowCandidates`, `#readFlattenedMetaItems` (the narrowing), PR #28507's AGREEMENT pin and *unbound row still wins* pin |
| 3 | an undeclared pair row or a dependent's row is an orphan in the layered read's `overlay`, `effective` = the base's | `protocol.ts#getMetaItemLayered` (orphan block) |
| 4 | an override may narrow a public form's anonymous intake, never re-open one any honoured body withdrew | `packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts#resolveFormBySlug` (withdrawal judged against the effective list beside `getMetaItemsPerPackage`) |
| 5 | `GET /packages/hotcrm.custom/export` carries it with `overrides`; the base's is unchanged | `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` (export reads `getMetaItemsPerPackage`) |

Not taught, because it is not on `main`: the write gate that refuses an undeclared same-name item (N-09), the flow/action override doors (N-11), the pair's auto-creation (N-13), the migration (N-16).

**Paid by deletion in the same file** — the row stays at 6014, no raise, headroom 8 → 0. Each deletion and where its rule still lives:

| Deleted | Bytes | Still taught at |
|:--|--:|:--|
| the CLI cheat-sheet bash block under `## CLI Commands` (:438; the pointer sentence stays) | 537 | every line is a row of `references/operations.md`: `os init`/`create-objectstack` :10, `os dev --ui` :12, `os validate` :13, `os compile` :23, `os start` :25 and the port rule :78, `os migrate plan`/`apply` :96 |
| the "Runtime rule of thumb" table under `### Compile Artifact…` (:93) | 330 | its *Local dev* and *Production runtime* rows restate the paragraph above it ("metadata must come from source files during local development or from a compiled artifact … never through its business database"); the *Control plane* row named no author action |
| the sentence under that table ("keep object names short and `snake_case`; never set `tableName`, and do not add `sys_metadata` objects…") | 190 (−85 re-added) | folded into **Object naming** (:130): "Never set `tableName`, and never add a `sys_metadata` object to a runtime manifest" — both refusals stay in this file (the ratchet's own comment on this row records that the `sys_metadata` clause must not leave SKILL.md); `snake_case` stays in the Naming Conventions table |
| the Seed Data sentence "In particular `object` is derived from the object definition: never write it by hand, and never hand-write a raw `data: [{ object: … }]` literal." (:400) | 148 | `objectstack-data/references/seeds.md` :50 (`object` · derived · never write manually), which the preceding sentence already sends the reader to for "which keys are derived"; `defineSeed()` stays in the first sentence |
| two doubled `---` rules | 8 | — |

Withdrawn from the plan I reported to the seat: the seed `mode` line. `check:skill-identifier-liveness` holds `## Seed Data` exhaustive over `SeedMode` ("The mode table is the only place an author learns what `mode` accepts"), so deleting it reds the gate and its ledger is maintainer-only; the `object`-is-derived sentence pays instead.

skills/** readings — file: `SKILL.md` 6006 → **6014** tokens (ceiling 6014; 24042 → 24073 bytes; the addition is 1176 bytes, the deletions 1213 with 85 re-added). Whole package: every other priced file unchanged; the eval fixture `evals/config-plugins-ops.json` 1676 → 1987 tokens (measured, not ratcheted). No ratchet row moves.

### `skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json` — case 10 (:95)

An author who installed HotCRM replaces `crm_account_grid` so every read serves theirs and the change exports. Expected: the whole view under the same name in `hotcrm.custom` with `overrides: { package: 'hotcrm', basedOn: '3.2.0' }`; `must_contain` the pair id, `overrides:`, `package: 'hotcrm'`, `basedOn`; `must_not_contain` `objectExtensions`, `allowEnvironmentOverlay`. Appended in the file's own formatting (10 lines).

### `.changeset/28509-custom-override-read-teaching.md`

`'@objectstack/skills': patch`, with `Clause-②: no` / `Metadata-protocol: none` and the before/now/budget record.

### `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx` — new `###` under *Package-first authoring (ADR-0070)* (:114–:143)

Points 1–3 and 5, in the page that owns the layered read (`getMetaItemLayered()` returns `code` / `overlay` / `effective`, :49), `?package=` and read-only installed packages (:89–:113) and the overlay-whitelist row story (the table right below, which the new text names as "the package-unbound row"). The declaration's schema is linked once: `/docs/references/kernel/override-declaration` (generated from N-08's zod).

### `content/docs/ui/forms.mdx` — one sentence (:23)

Point 4, after "Clearing either switch withdraws the form from every anonymous endpoint." — the page that owns the anonymous endpoints' withdrawal contract.

### Docs pages checked and not edited

| Page | Why not |
|:--|:--|
| `content/docs/references/system/metadata-persistence.mdx` | `⚠️ AUTO-GENERATED — DO NOT EDIT` from `packages/spec/src/system/metadata-persistence.zod.ts`; carries no hand-written sentence; the declaration's text lives in the spec `describe()` (N-08) |
| `content/docs/references/api/package-api.mdx` | auto-generated likewise; the Package API schema has no export route |
| `content/docs/api/metadata-api.mdx` | its `GET /meta/:type` and § Package Management document neither `?package=` nor `/packages/:id/export`; the facts sit once, on the lifecycle page |
| `content/docs/kernel/contracts/metadata-service.mdx` | route table (:497–:500) lists the `/packages` routes without export; same reason |
| `content/docs/build-without-code.mdx` :38, `content/docs/capabilities/integrations.mdx` :18 | "views and dashboards are yours to edit directly" is still true on `main`: the package-unbound Setup row wins until D11; D4 (Setup › Packaged automation retires) has not landed |
| `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx` § Overlay whitelist | kept as is: it describes the row the new subsection calls package-unbound |

No hand-written page mentioned `.custom`, `overrides.package` or `basedOn` before this PR. The generated `content/docs/references/**` pages do, as schema rows from the spec `describe()` text (N-08): `references/kernel/override-declaration.mdx` (the declaration, with its docblock prose), `references/api/metadata.mdx` :109, `references/api/automation-api.mdx`, `references/api/package-lifecycle.mdx`, `references/automation/flow.mdx`, `references/data/mapping.mdx`, `references/data/object.mdx`, `references/kernel/metadata-plugin.mdx` — all `AUTO-GENERATED — DO NOT EDIT`, none edited; the lifecycle subsection links the declaration reference. My report to the seat said "nothing on the site mentions `.custom`"; that was true of the hand-written pages only, corrected here.

## Why

Card #28509 (p1, N-10's owed skills-docs half, `Skills-docs: follow-up` of PR #28507): "A skill that still teaches the Setup overlay as the only customization path writes rows that the read treats as orphans, or as package-unbound rows awaiting N-16's migration. If nothing is done, agents keep writing the old shape." No skill or docs page on `main` carried the mechanism.

## Tests

No runtime tests owed (text and an eval fixture). The eval's assertions were checked against its own expected output (every `must_contain` present, no `must_not_contain` present). The SKILL.md edits were applied by an anchored script asserting one hit per anchor, so no deletion missed or doubled silently.

## Acceptance notes

- The five facts are stated as what an author writes and what the read serves; no engine internals are named in the skill (the predicate, the per-package layer and the candidate list are named only in this body).
- `flow`/`action` are in `OVERRIDABLE_METADATA_TYPES` with D9 conditions, and the read declines a stored flow body before it asks the predicate; the skill says "not `flow`/`action` yet" and the docs page says why.
- The skill says the pair "depends on" the base (ADR-0146 D3; the dependency is what install resolution reads) without claiming any door enforces it today: N-13's ensure door is not on `main`.
- The docs subsection calls the overlay-whitelist row "the package-unbound row — the overlay row of the table below", so the two stories on one page read as one.
- The harness's assignee/reviewer step is skipped: this card writes to GitHub only through the relay, and the PR is Tier H — the seat runs the Fable contract review and hands it to the approver.
- Out-of-scope findings: none. (Five derived gates exit 3, "prerequisite not met", on a fresh worktree until the packages are built — `check:docs-transcript-drift`, lint `check:doc-formula-expressions`, spec `check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`; all five ran green after the build named under Verification. Not a finding.)
